---
id: v-2-tenants-patch
title: "Update a tenant"
description: "Update a tenant's `first_name`, `last_name`, or `phone`, re-key their `external_tenant_id` when the id you gave earlier has changed, or claim a tenant that carries none of your ids by sending `external_tenant_id` with a `phone` matching what KISS already has on file. Send at least one. Addressed by the KISS `tenant_id` (ULID). A re-key or claim moves the id everywhere the tenant is used, so their units and any linked guests move with it. A claim's `phone` is proof only and is never written; it answers `409 claim_phone_required` when missing, `409 claim_phone_mismatch` when it does not parse or does not match what KISS holds, and `409 claim_raced` if a concurrent write already linked the tenant to a different id first. Both a re-key and a claim answer `409 external_tenant_id_conflict` if another tenant already holds the id. Returns the updated tenant in the same shape as `GET /tenants/{tenant_id}`, plus `meta.warnings`. Answers `409` for a non-claim write to a tenant carrying no id from your system, an ambiguous target, or a change that reaches locations your token cannot; see [Updating a tenant](/guides/pms/quickstart#updating-a-tenant). Needs the `tenants:write` scope."

Update a tenant's `first_name`, `last_name`, or `phone`, re-key their `external_tenant_id` when the id you gave earlier has changed, or claim a tenant that carries none of your ids by sending `external_tenant_id` with a `phone` matching what KISS already has on file. Send at least one. Addressed by the KISS `tenant_id` (ULID). A re-key or claim moves the id everywhere the tenant is used, so their units and any linked guests move with it. A claim's `phone` is proof only and is never written; it answers `409 claim_phone_required` when missing, `409 claim_phone_mismatch` when it does not parse or does not match what KISS holds, and `409 claim_raced` if a concurrent write already linked the tenant to a different id first. Both a re-key and a claim answer `409 external_tenant_id_conflict` if another tenant already holds the id. Returns the updated tenant in the same shape as `GET /tenants/{tenant_id}`, plus `meta.warnings`. Answers `409` for a non-claim write to a tenant carrying no id from your system, an ambiguous target, or a change that reaches locations your token cannot; see [Updating a tenant](/guides/pms/quickstart#updating-a-tenant). Needs the `tenants:write` scope.
